      <div class="row">
        <div style="flex:1;min-width:140px"><label class="mut">Your commission %</label><input id="commIn" type="number" min="0" max="50" step="0.5"></div>

<div id="toast"></div>
<script>
var SB="https://ehbdvjkguungjccaaqsm.supabase.co/rest/v1",KEY="sb_publishable_ip0uOdOcSplrTkOIw5MDnA_jwSe6jDa";
var AK=localStorage.getItem("aurisi_admin_key")||"";
var PCT=10,SALES=[],COURSES=[],INSTS=[];
function H(){return{apikey:KEY,Authorization:"Bearer "+KEY,"Content-Type":"application/json"}}
function toast(m){var t=document.getElementById("toast");t.textContent=m;t.classList.add("show");setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove("show")},2400)}
async function rpc(fn,body){var r=await fetch(SB+"/rpc/"+fn,{method:"POST",headers:H(),body:JSON.stringify(body)});return await r.json()}
function escH(s){return String(s==null?"":s).replace(/[&<>"']/g,function(c){return "&#"+c.charCodeAt(0)+";"})}
function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function go(p){
  ["Dash","Inst","Sales","Codes","Set"].forEach(function(x){
    $("pg"+x).classList.toggle("hide",x!==p);
    $("tab"+x).classList.toggle("on",x===p);
  });
  if(p==="Sales")renderSales();
}

async function doLogin(){
  var k=$("keyIn").value.trim();
  if(!k)return;
  var ok=await rpc("admin_login",{p_key:k});
  if(ok!==true){toast("Wrong HQ key");return}
  AK=k;localStorage.setItem("aurisi_admin_key",k);showDash();
}
function logout(){localStorage.removeItem("aurisi_admin_key");location.reload()}
function showDash(){$("loginCard").classList.add("hide");$("dash").classList.remove("hide");refreshAll()}

async function refreshAll(){await loadSwitches();loadKpis();loadInsts();loadCodes();loadLogins()}

async function loadSwitches(){
  try{
    var r=await fetch(SB+"/app_config?select=key,value",{headers:H()});
    var rows=await r.json();
    var m={};rows.forEach(function(x){m[x.key]=x.value});
    var p=parseFloat(m.commission_pct);if(p>=0&&p<=50)PCT=p;
    $("pctNote").textContent="Commission: "+PCT+"% per sale";
    $("commIn").value=String(PCT);
    if(m.aurisi_fee_upi)$("upiIn").value=m.aurisi_fee_upi;
    if(m.github_publish_token)$("ghTok").value=m.github_publish_token;
    var b1=$("swPro"),b2=$("swBiz");
    b1.textContent=m.student_pro_enabled==="true"?"ON":"OFF";
    b1.className="sm "+(m.student_pro_enabled==="true"?"on":"off");
    b2.textContent=m.biz_mode==="visible"?"VISIBLE":"HIDDEN";
    b2.className="sm "+(m.biz_mode==="visible"?"on":"off");
    var hk=m.ai_house_key||"";
    $("hkIn").placeholder=hk?("Current: "+hk.slice(0,4)+"..."+hk.slice(-4)):"Paste Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com)";
  }catch(e){toast("Could not reach server")}
}
async function togglePro(){var on=$("swPro").textContent==="ON";await rpc("admin_set_config",{p_key:AK,p_cfg:"student_pro_enabled",p_value:on?"false":"true"});toast(on?"Students Pro OFF — app is free":"Students Pro ON — Pro code required");loadSwitches()}
async function toggleBiz(){var on=$("swBiz").textContent==="VISIBLE";await rpc("admin_set_config",{p_key:AK,p_cfg:"biz_mode",p_value:on?"hidden":"visible"});toast(on?"Business section HIDDEN":"Business section VISIBLE");loadSwitches()}
async function saveHK(){var k=$("hkIn").value.trim();if(!k){toast("Paste the key first");return}
  var ok=await rpc("admin_set_config",{p_key:AK,p_cfg:"ai_house_key",p_value:k});
  toast(ok===true?"House AI key saved — chat works for everyone":"Failed");loadSwitches()}
async function clearHK(){var ok=await rpc("admin_set_config",{p_key:AK,p_cfg:"ai_house_key",p_value:""});
  toast(ok===true?"House AI key removed":"Failed");$("hkIn").value="";loadSwitches()}
async function saveMoney(){
  var pct=parseFloat($("commIn").value);
  if(isNaN(pct)||pct<0||pct>50){toast("Commission must be 0-50%");return}
  var upi=$("upiIn").value.trim();
  var ok=await rpc("admin_set_config",{p_key:AK,p_cfg:"commission_pct",p_value:String(pct)});
  if(ok!==true){toast("Failed to save commission");return}
  if(upi){await rpc("admin_set_config",{p_key:AK,p_cfg:"aurisi_fee_upi",p_value:upi})}
  var tk=$("ghTok").value.trim();if(tk){await rpc("admin_set_config",{p_key:AK,p_cfg:"github_publish_token",p_value:tk})}
  toast("Money settings saved");loadSwitches();loadKpis();
}

async function makeCode(){
  var days=parseInt($("daysIn").value,10);
  var kind=$("kindIn").value;
  var note=$("noteIn").value.trim();
  var code=await rpc("admin_make_code",{p_key:AK,p_days:days,p_kind:kind,p_note:note});
  var box=$("newCodeBox");
  if(typeof code!=="string"||code.indexOf("ERR:")===0){toast(code||"Failed");box.innerHTML="";return}
  box.innerHTML='<div class="newcode">New '+escH(kind)+' code — <code>'+code+'</code> ('+days+' days)<br><small>'+escH(note||"")+'</small></div>';
  toast("Code generated — copy and send it");
  loadCodes();
}

async function loadKpis(){
  try{
    var cfg=await fetch(SB+"/app_config?select=key,value&key=eq.commission_pct",{headers:H()});var cr=await cfg.json();
    if(cr&&cr.length){var p=parseFloat(cr[0].value);if(p>=0&&p<=50)PCT=p}
    var rc=await fetch(SB+"/inst_courses?select=id,inst_code,price",{headers:H()});COURSES=await rc.json();
    var rk=await fetch(SB+"/course_codes?select=course_id,used,price_at_sale",{headers:H()});SALES=await rk.json();
    var gross=0,sold=0;
    SALES.forEach(function(s){if(s.used){gross+=(s.price_at_sale||0);sold++}});
    var fee=Math.round(gross*PCT/100);
    var ri=await rpc("admin_list_institutes",{p_key:AK});INSTS=(ri&&ri.length)?ri:[];
    var act=INSTS.filter(function(x){return x.active}).length;
    var rl=await fetch(SB+"/inst_login?select=email",{headers:H()});var lg=await rl.json();
    $("kpiBox").innerHTML=
      '<div class="kpi"><small>Institutes</small><b>'+INSTS.length+'</b><small class="mut">'+act+' active</small></div>'
      +'<div class="kpi"><small>Courses live</small><b>'+COURSES.length+'</b><small class="mut">'+(lg?lg.length:0)+' portal logins</small></div>'
      +'<div class="kpi"><small>Codes sold</small><b>'+sold+'</b><small class="mut">course access codes</small></div>'
